column2: Sin is being turned away, after knowledge, from the work of one's own hand; its contrary is to stand facing that same work as one's own, which attention alone does not do. Repentance contains that contrary only once it arrives at that facing, and grace is that facing insofar as it is given.

Sin is being turned away, after knowledge, from the work of one's own hand; its contrary is to stand facing that work as one's own. Repentance holds that contrary only once it comes to stand there, and grace is that facing insofar as it is given.
